description: The whole Cardano NFT market over the last 7, 30, 90 or 365 days: sales, volume (ADA), active buyers and sellers (distinct wallets over the window where it can be counted, else the daily average), and for each marketplace its volume, share, marketplace fees and creator royalties (over the sales whose split is recorded, with the coverage). Sales whose buyer and seller are the same wallet are left out.
name: get_nft_market
title: Whole NFT market overview
